summary: Request for a 'summoned' combat-log entry, raised by esv::summon::SpawnSystem::ProcessCombatLogRequests (game bg3.exe+0x2DCED30, from a list of 16-byte entity pairs in the system's frame data) and consumed by esv::combat_log::CombatLogSystem::ProcessSummonSpawnRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x46F580), which builds an eoc::CombatLog::SummonedEntry with two CombatLog::NetEntity values from +0 and +8. Seen.py context: born in 'spells-5' (summoning spells) and in fights with summoning enemies (S_HAG_WoodWoad, mud mephits, cloaker).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DCFBC0 defaults to the null handle; bg3.exe+0x2DCED30 writes the second handle of the frame-data pair here; ProcessSummonSpawnRequests turns it into the entry's first NetEntity. Live: entity handles. Summon vs. summoner not established.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Default null handle; bg3.exe+0x2DCED30 writes the first handle of the pair (the one checked by FUN_14302d780 / FUN_140f345b0 before logging); becomes the entry's second NetEntity. Live: entity handles.

open_questions: Which handle is the summon and which the summoner (eoc::CombatLog::SummonedEntry member names not found).
